decision.explanation: Three distinct individuals named 'Judge Ritter' are referenced across the documents. Document 1 (D1S2) states that Halsted L. Ritter was born on July 14, 1868, and this is supported by D1S4. Document 2 (D2S2) states that another Halsted L. Ritter was born on January 1, 1900, and this is supported by D2S4. Document 3 (D3S1) refers to Willis William Ritter, who was born on January 24, 1899. These are separate referents with distinct birth dates, and each is independently supported by their respective documents. The R5_answers include all three, and the proposed candidates C3 and C4 align with the direct textual evidence in D1S2 and D2S2 respectively.
